STEP 1 - Vessel type: square flat plate (rim band visible, flat centre, no inner wall).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Square plates are typically 20-30 cm; this one looks like a medium-large square dinner plate, around 25 cm.
b) Reference: the chicken drumstick-like piece on the right is roughly 11 cm long, and the plate's edge spans about 2.2 drumstick lengths across the frame, giving about 24-25 cm. Cherry tomato (3 cm) at the lower right appears about 1/8 of the plate width, again about 24 cm.
Final width: 25 cm (square), area = 625 cm².

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Chicken (two pieces, roughly breast/thigh meat): covers about 30% of the plate, about 190 cm². Thickness: pieces are about 2.5 cm thick, stacked about one deep at the thickest point, so average ~2 cm. Volume = 380 ml x 1.0 = 380 g... taken as ~2.5 cm average over the thickest area, a conservative estimate is about 250 g.
- Rice (mixed with chicken, sauce-stained base): covers about 15% of plate, ~94 cm², average 1.5 cm (mound centre ~3 cm). Volume = 140 ml x 0.8 = 112 g.
- Cooked leafy greens (spinach/kale, sautéed): about 10% of plate, ~63 cm², thickness ~0.8 cm. Volume = 50 ml x 0.6 = 30 g.
- Cherry tomatoes (yellow): 2 visible, ~1 hidden: 3 x 15 g = 45 g.
- Sauce (brown glaze/pan sauce) on the base: ~40 cm² x 0.3 cm = 12 ml x 1.0 = 12 g.

Total ≈ 250 + 112 + 30 + 45 + 12 = 449 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: rice base under the chicken is already counted; no extra layer is clearly visible beyond that.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served):
- Chicken (roasted/cooked meat): 190 kcal
- Cooked rice: 130 kcal
- Cooked leafy greens (sautéed in oil): 60 kcal
- Cherry tomato: 18 kcal
- Sauce (glaze/oil-based): 90 kcal

Estimated energy: chicken 475 + rice 146 + greens 18 + tomato 8 + sauce 11 ≈ 658 kcal total.
